name: @ihabbishara/aios
//files: Allowlist, not a convenience. agents/ is the USER's org and is not even tracked any more — the runtime creates it on first run and seeds it from templates/, which is what makes a fresh install reach the setup wizard. templates/_capabilities.yaml is product data seedCapabilities() throws without, so templates/ MUST ship. dist/src/ not dist/: tsconfig compiles test/ too, so dist/test/ holds client-named fixtures. ui2/dist/ is the cockpit AND the setup wizard — both servers resolve assets from it, so without it a fresh install 404s on the very first screen. NOTE: `files` OVERRIDES .gitignore, which is why gitignored dist/ ships at all.

scripts.//build: Clean first: tsc never prunes outputs whose source was deleted or renamed, so dist/ accumulated modules that no longer exist in src/ (packs/, finance/agent, engine/executor, engine/jobs) and npm pack shipped them as dead code. A renamed guard kept its old client-named file alive there too.
scripts.//prepack: npm pack ships whatever is on disk. Both build outputs are gitignored, so publishing without this produces a tarball that is stale or has no code at all — and looks successful.
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm --prefix ui2 run build
